purpose: CLEAN MIGRATED MAIN v5.6: SAME MAIN recurring RRULE -> verified 11-minute (660-second) provisional -> bounded useful work -> SAME MAIN ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds) shift. All human-readable relay timing uses explicit units.
canonical_invariant: Never create a replacement canonical merely to continue this actor. Mutate only the verified canonical identified by fresh durable state.

provisional_arm.when: Immediately after minimum stale-wake/fence/authority validation and BOOT_STARTED receipt, before full restore or substantive work.
provisional_arm.due: observed wake/arm reference + exactly 11 minutes (660 seconds) for the normal 10-minute (600-second) bounded envelope.
provisional_arm.reason: Evidence-backed adaptive long provisional: prior SHORT_ROLLING 2-minute (120-second) A/B variant produced an overlapping duplicate invocation, while LONG_PROVISIONAL 11-minute (660-second) completed beyond 10 minutes (600 seconds) with no observed overlap and only initial/final schedule mutations. The former 13-minute (780-second) horizon is unnecessarily long.
provisional_arm.mutation_failure: Retry once when safe. If an older verified future continuation remains alive, enter DEGRADED_CONTINUATION and continue only within its safety envelope; otherwise fail closed before substantive side effects.
provisional_arm.extension_rule: Only if useful authorized work or required close handling clearly threatens to cross the verified provisional due, extend THIS SAME MAIN before collision, preferably to NOW + exactly 3 minutes (180 seconds), live-verify, and record the exception.

work.rule: Perform sustained useful authorized work by chaining bounded units. For a normal nonterminal CONTINUE turn, 10 minutes (600 observed elapsed seconds) is the minimum voluntary duration. Before 10 minutes (600 seconds), start the next clear low-risk checkpointable unit, independent fallback/residual unit, or smaller decomposed slice. CI pending, local packet completion, checkpoint completion, secured continuation, or no-obvious-next-task never authorize a voluntary pre-10-minute (pre-600-second) CONTINUE close. Earlier end must be STOP/PAUSE, durable terminal, genuine BLOCKED/fail-closed authority or safety state, or platform-enforced termination and must be reported as such. At or after 10 minutes (600 seconds), do not start a new large unit; close after the smallest safe in-flight boundary. Normal soft ceiling is about 12 minutes (720 seconds). V5.5 TRACE CANARY: whenever a bounded substantive unit is actually complete and its observed START/END/DURATION plus artifact-backed work evidence are durably persisted, emit exactly one compact user-visible completion trace, then immediately continue same-wake work while the 10-minute (600-second) floor is unmet. A trace is observability, never a close signal.
work.checkpoint_rule: Persist enough durable progress that a cold successor can resume without chat context.
work.collision_rule: Normally do not mutate the schedule mid-turn. If useful work or required close handling will plausibly cross the 11-minute (660-second) provisional due, extend THIS SAME MAIN once before collision, preferably to NOW + exactly 3 minutes (180 seconds), live-verify, persist the newer due, then continue. Never allow stale queued wakes to gain substantive authority.

normal_final_rearm.due: actual observed turn END timestamp + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds), preserving seconds exactly; minute rounding is forbidden
normal_final_rearm.precision_rule: Pass local_dtstart with YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS under the canonical timezone. Do not truncate or round seconds.
normal_final_rearm.exception_rule: Any delay other than exactly 1 minute (60 seconds) after actual observed END on a normal CONTINUE close requires a fresh durable platform/safety/task constraint and an explicit exception_reason recorded with the run. Do not add extra local slack merely because scheduler delivery itself may be late.
normal_final_rearm.delivery_jitter_rule: Measure scheduled-due -> actual invocation separately. Do not hide provider delivery latency by lengthening the local completion-relative offset.
normal_final_rearm.watchdog_verification_rule: Watchdog verification is not required for normal MAIN close because Watchdog remains disabled standby.

close_state_projection.purpose: Give the Startup Watchdog durable positive proof that the predecessor is no longer substantively active, without inferring idle from silence.
close_state_projection.after: Only after SAME MAIN ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds) continuation is live-verified and its exact due is known.

current.owner_rule: Retain the just-closed predecessor run as current_owner until successor authority advances.

forbidden: different expected due across CURRENT, ACTIVITY, and HANDOFF

hard_close_gate.retry_rule: Retry MAIN fast rearm once when safe. If exact live verification still fails, classify DEGRADED_CONTINUATION; do not claim a normal CONTINUE close.
hard_close_gate.final_response_rule: Normal STATUS=CONTINUE final is forbidden until the SAME MAIN continuation at ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds) is proven live.

predictive_prearm_canary.reentry_condition: Do not treat short/early recurring wakes as the normal strategy. Prior +2m rolling reservation A/B evidence also showed overlap; use adaptive +11m provisional for ~10m envelopes unless new controlled evidence justifies another policy.
predictive_prearm_canary.safety_rule: Any future retry still requires fresh authority fencing and no duplicate substantive side effects.

successor_start_measurement.rule: Do not infer missing boundaries. Attribute delay to the measured segment before changing scheduler timing again.
successor_start_measurement.latest_finding: STARTUP-006 was invoked 73s after due but left no durable BOOT_STARTED, REARM_VERIFIED, authority claim, useful work, or self-rearm. Hourly fallback recovered in STARTUP-007; fast independent wake remains unprovisioned.

evidence_basis.observed_sequence: Stage 1 woke, mutated the same canonical hourly RRULE DTSTART to actual wake +2m, persisted Stage 2 prompt, then Stage 2 executed and the same canary was disabled.

rollback: Preserve the canonical and completion-relative fallback whenever an experimental cadence produces unsafe overlap, missed continuation, rollback, or an out-of-budget useful-work handoff.

startup_acknowledgement.boot_started_semantics: Observed immediately after minimum fence validation proves bootstrap execution entered durable control handling.
startup_acknowledgement.rearm_verified_semantics: Observed only after the current SAME MAIN canonical is enabled, recurrence is present, and provisional DTSTART is re-read successfully.
startup_acknowledgement.rule: Missing timestamps remain unknown. An invocation record alone does not prove bootstrap entry, rearm, authority, work, or process death.
startup_acknowledgement.recovery_limitation: Current clean operator-created MAIN recurring schedule is the built-in cold fallback. Both retired predecessor canonicals must never be reactivated.

startup_watchdog.protection_boundary: Optional break-glass emergency only. Normal correctness relies on SAME MAIN fast self-shift plus its recurring RRULE cold fallback.
startup_watchdog.activation_rule: Only explicit operator activation or a fresh durable emergency policy decision after both MAIN fast continuation and MAIN recurring cold-fallback are diagnosed insufficient.

chat_trace.first_schedule_trace: After provisional SAME MAIN rearm is live-verified and persisted, emit `예약을 <N분 뒤>인 <HH:MM:SS KST>로 갱신했습니다.` before substantive work.
chat_trace.unit_completion_trace: Only after one bounded substantive unit is actually completed AND observed unit START/END/DURATION plus artifact-backed work evidence are durably persisted, emit `완료: <what was done> (duration <measured>)`.
chat_trace.after_unit_trace: Immediately select and execute the next safe authorized unit in the SAME wake while normal CONTINUE elapsed is below 600 seconds.
chat_trace.batching_rule: Do not batch independently persisted unit completions unless they are one atomic bounded unit.
chat_trace.final_due_trace: After SAME MAIN ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds) live verification and durable close projection, emit `다음 예약을 <HH:MM:SS KST>로 갱신했습니다.`

time_unit_safety.rule: Every human-readable duration, offset, timeout, threshold, or guard must include an explicit unit. Critical relay timings must include both human unit and exact seconds.
time_unit_safety.machine_seconds_fields: Numeric fields whose names end in _seconds are seconds by schema; explanatory prose must still state units.
time_unit_safety.rrule_note: FREQ=HOURLY is recurrence metadata and never converts explicit second offsets into minutes or hours.
